meta.title: Doubt
meta.description: Cut off the head and the body will die. The enemy can only be defeated when you know where their mastermind is.

units.rawText: At the Rossum Sector, in the temporary shelter near the Admin Center.
units.displayText: At the Rossum Sector, in the temporary shelter near the Admin Center.

spans.text: At the Rossum Sector, in the temporary shelter near the Admin Center.

units.rawText: Turing, Sol, you ready?
units.displayText: Turing, Sol, you ready?

spans.text: Turing, Sol, you ready?

units.rawText: No problem!
units.displayText: No problem!

spans.text: No problem!

units.rawText: Ready to comply.
units.displayText: Ready to comply.

spans.text: Ready to comply.

units.rawText: Good. Anyway, don't be too hasty. Wait until Hannah's team makes it past that main road before moving out. Remember, stick to the shadows of the buildings and don't let them see you.
units.displayText: Good. Anyway, don't be too hasty. Wait until Hannah's team makes it past that main road before moving out. Remember, stick to the shadows of the buildings and don't let them see you.

spans.text: Good. Anyway, don't be too hasty. Wait until Hannah's team makes it past that main road before moving out. Remember, stick to the shadows of the buildings and don't let them see you.

units.rawText: Sure. What's gotten you so knotted up over the details today, anyway?
units.displayText: Sure. What's gotten you so knotted up over the details today, anyway?

spans.text: Sure. What's gotten you so knotted up over the details today, anyway?

units.rawText: <size=28>I finally got a chance to recreate a classic tactic from Metal Suit, so I can't let anything go wrong...</size>
units.displayText: I finally got a chance to recreate a classic tactic from Metal Suit, so I can't let anything go wrong...

spans.text: I finally got a chance to recreate a classic tactic from Metal Suit, so I can't let anything go wrong...

units.rawText: Yes, yes. Relax, I'm prepared for this.
units.displayText: Yes, yes. Relax, I'm prepared for this.

spans.text: Yes, yes. Relax, I'm prepared for this.

units.rawText: Sol smiles broadly to her, and then looks back at Hannah.
units.displayText: Sol smiles broadly to her, and then looks back at Hannah.

spans.text: Sol smiles broadly to her, and then looks back at Hannah.

units.rawText: What about you, Hannah? Are you ready?
units.displayText: What about you, Hannah? Are you ready?

spans.text: What about you, Hannah? Are you ready?

units.rawText: We've divided the agent fighters into three teams that can support each other at a moment's notice. I've also finished suggesting deployment locations for Metal Suit Dirac.
units.displayText: We've divided the agent fighters into three teams that can support each other at a moment's notice. I've also finished suggesting deployment locations for Metal Suit Dirac.

spans.text: We've divided the agent fighters into three teams that can support each other at a moment's notice. I've also finished suggesting deployment locations for Metal Suit Dirac.

units.rawText: I had my agents repair and upgrade it slightly. Do you need some time for adjustments?
units.displayText: I had my agents repair and upgrade it slightly. Do you need some time for adjustments?

spans.text: I had my agents repair and upgrade it slightly. Do you need some time for adjustments?

units.rawText: Er, um... Nah. She's really good at this...
units.displayText: Er, um... Nah. She's really good at this...

spans.text: Er, um... Nah. She's really good at this...

units.rawText: Yep, she took the lead just like that.
units.displayText: Yep, she took the lead just like that.

spans.text: Yep, she took the lead just like that.

units.rawText: <size=28>I mean, I'm just a NEET who was never suited for leadership in the first place...</size>
units.displayText: I mean, I'm just a NEET who was never suited for leadership in the first place...

spans.text: I mean, I'm just a NEET who was never suited for leadership in the first place...

units.rawText: Ahem. Anyway, I'll repeat this one last time!
units.displayText: Ahem. Anyway, I'll repeat this one last time!

spans.text: Ahem. Anyway, I'll repeat this one last time!

units.rawText: Hannah will take her team toward the railgun—that is to say, in the opposite direction from the Data Center, and draw the Entropics' attention.
units.displayText: Hannah will take her team toward the railgun—that is to say, in the opposite direction from the Data Center, and draw the Entropics' attention.

spans.text: Hannah will take her team toward the railgun—that is to say, in the opposite direction from the Data Center, and draw the Entropics' attention.

units.rawText: Sol and Turing will use this opportunity to relocate to the Data Center.
units.displayText: Sol and Turing will use this opportunity to relocate to the Data Center.

spans.text: Sol and Turing will use this opportunity to relocate to the Data Center.

units.rawText: Once the Entropics are about to catch up with Hannah, we'll confront them with ambush troops and catch them off guard. Any questions?
units.displayText: Once the Entropics are about to catch up with Hannah, we'll confront them with ambush troops and catch them off guard. Any questions?

spans.text: Once the Entropics are about to catch up with Hannah, we'll confront them with ambush troops and catch them off guard. Any questions?

units.rawText: <size=40>No questions!</size>
units.displayText: No questions!

spans.text: No questions!

units.rawText: A moment later, Hannah leads her people in a frantic dash down the main road as they make a beeline for the cannon platform.
units.displayText: A moment later, Hannah leads her people in a frantic dash down the main road as they make a beeline for the cannon platform.

spans.text: A moment later, Hannah leads her people in a frantic dash down the main road as they make a beeline for the cannon platform.

units.rawText: (Hisses and snarls)
units.displayText: Hisses and snarls

spans.text: Hisses and snarls

units.rawText: The Entropics are swarming! They're coming after us, as expected!
units.displayText: The Entropics are swarming! They're coming after us, as expected!

spans.text: The Entropics are swarming! They're coming after us, as expected!

units.rawText: Calm down. How far are they from you?
units.displayText: Calm down. How far are they from you?

spans.text: Calm down. How far are they from you?

units.rawText: I'm very calm. They're roughly 200 meters away, and the Entropics are slightly faster than us.
units.displayText: I'm very calm. They're roughly 200 meters away, and the Entropics are slightly faster than us.

spans.text: I'm very calm. They're roughly 200 meters away, and the Entropics are slightly faster than us.

units.rawText: Good, bring them in like that.
units.displayText: Good, bring them in like that.

spans.text: Good, bring them in like that.

units.rawText: Dirac's already warmed up and ready to sortie at any time. I'll intercept them at that signboard.
units.displayText: Dirac's already warmed up and ready to sortie at any time. I'll intercept them at that signboard.

spans.text: Dirac's already warmed up and ready to sortie at any time. I'll intercept them at that signboard.

units.rawText: Got it.
units.displayText: Got it.

spans.text: Got it.

units.rawText: Croque pilots Dirac into the shadows behind a building and waits quietly.
units.displayText: Croque pilots Dirac into the shadows behind a building and waits quietly.

spans.text: Croque pilots Dirac into the shadows behind a building and waits quietly.

units.rawText: We're past the signboard! The Entropics are about 170 meters behind us!
units.displayText: We're past the signboard! The Entropics are about 170 meters behind us!

spans.text: We're past the signboard! The Entropics are about 170 meters behind us!

units.rawText: Keep running! Don't let them even expect anything amiss!
units.displayText: Keep running! Don't let them even expect anything amiss!

spans.text: Keep running! Don't let them even expect anything amiss!

units.rawText: They're approaching the signboard!
units.displayText: They're approaching the signboard!

spans.text: They're approaching the signboard!

units.rawText: Now we've got them all in one shot—
units.displayText: Now we've got them all in one shot—

spans.text: Now we've got them all in one shot—

units.rawText: With the Entropic horde just a few steps away from the ambush point, Croque aims Dirac's guns forward...
units.displayText: With the Entropic horde just a few steps away from the ambush point, Croque aims Dirac's guns forward...

spans.text: With the Entropic horde just a few steps away from the ambush point, Croque aims Dirac's guns forward...

units.rawText: <color=purple>Stop.</color>
units.displayText: Stop.

spans.text: Stop.

units.rawText: <color=purple>A hidden backdrop... A simple ploy... Something is wrong.</color>
units.displayText: A hidden backdrop... A simple ploy... Something is wrong.

spans.text: A hidden backdrop... A simple ploy... Something is wrong.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Fall back...</color>
units.displayText: Fall back...

spans.text: Fall back...

units.rawText: Who's that... Is it a High-Order Entropic? Croque! Use the backup plan!
units.displayText: Who's that... Is it a High-Order Entropic? Croque! Use the backup plan!

spans.text: Who's that... Is it a High-Order Entropic? Croque! Use the backup plan!

units.rawText: On it!
units.displayText: On it!

spans.text: On it!

units.rawText: There is a loud crash and the Metal Suit emerges from its hiding, strafing with its cannons.
units.displayText: There is a loud crash and the Metal Suit emerges from its hiding, strafing with its cannons.

spans.text: There is a loud crash and the Metal Suit emerges from its hiding, strafing with its cannons.

units.rawText: Turn around! Back Croque up!
units.displayText: Turn around! Back Croque up!

spans.text: Turn around! Back Croque up!

units.rawText: <color=purple>Begin... the impromptu performance...</color>
units.displayText: Begin... the impromptu performance...

spans.text: Begin... the impromptu performance...

units.rawText: Though they were the ones being ambushed, the Entropic forces appear ready for this and form up before scattering to both sides of the main road.
units.displayText: Though they were the ones being ambushed, the Entropic forces appear ready for this and form up before scattering to both sides of the main road.

spans.text: Though they were the ones being ambushed, the Entropic forces appear ready for this and form up before scattering to both sides of the main road.

units.rawText: No, there's something wrong about their direction!
units.displayText: No, there's something wrong about their direction!

spans.text: No, there's something wrong about their direction!

units.rawText: <color=purple>This is a feint... the real star... is on the other side of the stage...</color>
units.displayText: This is a feint... the real star... is on the other side of the stage...

spans.text: This is a feint... the real star... is on the other side of the stage...

units.rawText: The Entropic horde changes direction—opposite of where Hannah's team is, where Sol and Turing's backs are visible in the distance.
units.displayText: The Entropic horde changes direction—opposite of where Hannah's team is, where Sol and Turing's backs are visible in the distance.

spans.text: The Entropic horde changes direction—opposite of where Hannah's team is, where Sol and Turing's backs are visible in the distance.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Shift the spotlights... towards...</color>
units.displayText: Shift the spotlights... towards...

spans.text: Shift the spotlights... towards...

units.rawText: They're heading toward the Data Center!
units.displayText: They're heading toward the Data Center!

spans.text: They're heading toward the Data Center!

units.rawText: Tch, not only did they see through the ambush, but now they're trying to turn it around on us?
units.displayText: Tch, not only did they see through the ambush, but now they're trying to turn it around on us?

spans.text: Tch, not only did they see through the ambush, but now they're trying to turn it around on us?

units.rawText: We can't let them catch up to Turing!
units.displayText: We can't let them catch up to Turing!

spans.text: We can't let them catch up to Turing!

units.rawText: Have a taste of my fully-charged—<size=40>PULSE BOMBARDMENT!</size>
units.displayText: Have a taste of my fully-charged—PULSE BOMBARDMENT!

spans.text: Have a taste of my fully-charged—
PULSE BOMBARDMENT!

units.rawText: The Metal Suit surges forward, delivering a vicious assault against the retreating Entropics.
units.displayText: The Metal Suit surges forward, delivering a vicious assault against the retreating Entropics.

spans.text: The Metal Suit surges forward, delivering a vicious assault against the retreating Entropics.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Too many casualties... cast... diminishing...</color>
units.displayText: Too many casualties... cast... diminishing...

spans.text: Too many casualties... cast... diminishing...

units.rawText: <color=purple>Avoid stage battle... evade...</color>
units.displayText: Avoid stage battle... evade...

spans.text: Avoid stage battle... evade...

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: They're dispersing into the alleys!
units.displayText: They're dispersing into the alleys!

spans.text: They're dispersing into the alleys!

units.rawText: Ugh... There's rubble and debris everywhere. Dirac can't get in... This is annoying.
units.displayText: Ugh... There's rubble and debris everywhere. Dirac can't get in... This is annoying.

spans.text: Ugh... There's rubble and debris everywhere. Dirac can't get in... This is annoying.

units.rawText: Hannah, can I blow this place up?
units.displayText: Hannah, can I blow this place up?

spans.text: Hannah, can I blow this place up?

units.rawText: No, this row of buildings is linked! Blowing one up might lead to widespread secondary collapses, and there's no telling what the consequences might be!
units.displayText: No, this row of buildings is linked! Blowing one up might lead to widespread secondary collapses, and there's no telling what the consequences might be!

spans.text: No, this row of buildings is linked! Blowing one up might lead to widespread secondary collapses, and there's no telling what the consequences might be!

units.rawText: Did that Entropic factor that in as well?
units.displayText: Did that Entropic factor that in as well?

spans.text: Did that Entropic factor that in as well?

units.rawText: Croque tries to catch a glimpse of the Entropic leader as it flees.
units.displayText: Croque tries to catch a glimpse of the Entropic leader as it flees.

spans.text: Croque tries to catch a glimpse of the Entropic leader as it flees.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Cut supply lines... All-out attack...</color>
units.displayText: Cut supply lines... All-out attack...

spans.text: Cut supply lines... All-out attack...

units.rawText: <color=purple>Move the show... to the next scene...</color>
units.displayText: Move the show... to the next scene...

spans.text: Move the show... to the next scene...

units.rawText: Dammit...
units.displayText: Dammit...

spans.text: Dammit...

units.rawText: Croque watches as the enemy slithers away into the narrow gaps between the rubble, ultimately vanishing from sight.
units.displayText: Croque watches as the enemy slithers away into the narrow gaps between the rubble, ultimately vanishing from sight.

spans.text: Croque watches as the enemy slithers away into the narrow gaps between the rubble, ultimately vanishing from sight.

units.rawText: Hannah begins pursuing the Entropics, but Croque blocks her path with Dirac before she can go more than a few steps.
units.displayText: Hannah begins pursuing the Entropics, but Croque blocks her path with Dirac before she can go more than a few steps.

spans.text: Hannah begins pursuing the Entropics, but Croque blocks her path with Dirac before she can go more than a few steps.

units.rawText: Croque! Let me go, Turing and the others are in danger! Let me through!
units.displayText: Croque! Let me go, Turing and the others are in danger! Let me through!

spans.text: Croque! Let me go, Turing and the others are in danger! Let me through!

units.rawText: Hannah kicks Dirac's hand fruitlessly, but the sturdy metal won't give way.
units.displayText: Hannah kicks Dirac's hand fruitlessly, but the sturdy metal won't give way.

spans.text: Hannah kicks Dirac's hand fruitlessly, but the sturdy metal won't give way.

units.rawText: Don't be rash, Hannah! You can't beat them without a Metal Suit backing you up!
units.displayText: Don't be rash, Hannah! You can't beat them without a Metal Suit backing you up!

spans.text: Don't be rash, Hannah! You can't beat them without a Metal Suit backing you up!

units.rawText: I... I... (pants heavily)
units.displayText: I... I... (pants heavily)

spans.text: I... I... (pants heavily)

units.rawText: Calm down... Yes, that's right, calm down, Hannah. Just like that.
units.displayText: Calm down... Yes, that's right, calm down, Hannah. Just like that.

spans.text: Calm down... Yes, that's right, calm down, Hannah. Just like that.

units.rawText: ...I know.
units.displayText: ...I know.

spans.text: ...I know.

units.rawText: Hannah calms down and sits down in Dirac's palm.
units.displayText: Hannah calms down and sits down in Dirac's palm.

spans.text: Hannah calms down and sits down in Dirac's palm.

units.rawText: But they'll end up surrounded at this rate.
units.displayText: But they'll end up surrounded at this rate.

spans.text: But they'll end up surrounded at this rate.

units.rawText: The Entropics know the layout of this sector inside out. They saw through the plan just from the direction we were moving in, and they even took the collapse of the buildings into consideration... Any idea what this is all about?
units.displayText: The Entropics know the layout of this sector inside out. They saw through the plan just from the direction we were moving in, and they even took the collapse of the buildings into consideration... Any idea what this is all about?

spans.text: The Entropics know the layout of this sector inside out. They saw through the plan just from the direction we were moving in, and they even took the collapse of the buildings into consideration... Any idea what this is all about?

units.rawText: I'm not sure. No outsider should know the Rossum Sector's layout this well. Could it be from before I was created...
units.displayText: I'm not sure. No outsider should know the Rossum Sector's layout this well. Could it be from before I was created...

spans.text: I'm not sure. No outsider should know the Rossum Sector's layout this well. Could it be from before I was created...

units.rawText: Well, there's nothing we can do about it at this point. All we can do is trust Sol and Turing's abilities. Rather, we should hurry up and...
units.displayText: Well, there's nothing we can do about it at this point. All we can do is trust Sol and Turing's abilities. Rather, we should hurry up and...

spans.text: Well, there's nothing we can do about it at this point. All we can do is trust Sol and Turing's abilities. Rather, we should hurry up and...

units.rawText: Yes, we should hurry up and finish our work at the cannon platform. The sooner we can free up some hands, the sooner we can back them up.
units.displayText: Yes, we should hurry up and finish our work at the cannon platform. The sooner we can free up some hands, the sooner we can back them up.

spans.text: Yes, we should hurry up and finish our work at the cannon platform. The sooner we can free up some hands, the sooner we can back them up.

units.rawText: <size=28>Why does everyone keep stealing my lines? Is the Professor the only one who has mastered the secret of not being interrupted by other people? I want to finish all those cool lines too...</size>
units.displayText: Why does everyone keep stealing my lines? Is the Professor the only one who has mastered the secret of not being interrupted by other people? I want to finish all those cool lines too...

spans.text: Why does everyone keep stealing my lines? Is the Professor the only one who has mastered the secret of not being interrupted by other people? I want to finish all those cool lines too...

units.rawText: Croque, let's go. Croque?
units.displayText: Croque, let's go. Croque?

spans.text: Croque, let's go. Croque?

units.rawText: I know, but before that...
units.displayText: I know, but before that...

spans.text: I know, but before that...

units.rawText: Croque taps her screen and brings up the comms interface.
units.displayText: Croque taps her screen and brings up the comms interface.

spans.text: Croque taps her screen and brings up the comms interface.

units.rawText: Let's inform the Professor first.
units.displayText: Let's inform the Professor first.

spans.text: Let's inform the Professor first.

units.rawText: Professor, we're on the way to the cannon control terminal.
units.displayText: Professor, we're on the way to the cannon control terminal.

spans.text: Professor, we're on the way to the cannon control terminal.

units.rawText: We spotted something that looks like an Entropic leader along the way... Sending it to you now.
units.displayText: We spotted something that looks like an Entropic leader along the way... Sending it to you now.

spans.text: We spotted something that looks like an Entropic leader along the way... Sending it to you now.

units.rawText: Sol's got a team of her own, too. There aren't that many of them, but they're quick on their feet. If they can finish transferring the operands quickly enough, we can take them out in one shot.
units.displayText: Sol's got a team of her own, too. There aren't that many of them, but they're quick on their feet. If they can finish transferring the operands quickly enough, we can take them out in one shot.

spans.text: Sol's got a team of her own, too. There aren't that many of them, but they're quick on their feet. If they can finish transferring the operands quickly enough, we can take them out in one shot.
